name: techdella/popup
title: Offer card (inline popup)
description: Inline end-of-post card with a short Startbuddi form. Either shows a popup configured under Growth → Popups (popupId), or its own copy. Exit-intent, slide-in and top-bar popups are placed automatically by the popup engine (§13.1), not with this block.

text.default: New guides on search, paid, email and automation. Unsubscribe any time.

attributes.title: Get the Journal by *email*
attributes.text: New guides on search, paid, email and automation. Unsubscribe any time.

techdella.help: popupId: the ID of a popup from Growth → Popups (its copy and form are used). Otherwise: headline (*accent* word), text, button label, form (newsletter | lead_magnet | popup_scroll | popup_exit) and, for a PDF offer, the resource slug.
